slides.stem: A salesperson earns a $5\%$ commission on the first $\$10{,}000$ in sales and $8\%$ on all sales above $\$10{,}000$. If the salesperson's total sales are $\$22{,}000$, what is the total commission?

slides.intro: Split the sales at the threshold, then rate each slice.
slides.trapWhy: $\$1{,}100$ applies $5\%$ to all $\$22{,}000$ and ignores the higher tier entirely.

slides.title: Slice at every threshold
slides.body:
Tiered rates never apply one percentage to the whole amount. Split at each threshold, rate each slice, add the pieces.

Taxes, commissions, and phone plans on the SAT all run on this one move.
